title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E03 — Backyard Bite
Outside Corpus Christi, Texas, Jeremy Sutcliffe is working in his garden when a rattlesnake bite puts him on the brink of death; while spearfishing in the Bahamas, Kent Bonde is blindsided by a bull shark that tears the calf muscle from his leg.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E07 — Formosan Clouded Leopard
Forrest tracks clues and eyewitness accounts suggesting that the Formosan clouded leopard is still alive after being declared extinct; he treks deep into the jungles of Taiwan where a run-in with a predator might just solve a mystery.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E04 — Florida Black Panther
Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for a predator rumored to exist for years, the Black Panther; it might be a case of mistaken identity, but while scouring the landscape, discoveries suggest that it might be more than a rumor.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E03 — White Wolf of Newfoundland
Forrest teams up with a specialist in Newfoundland in search of a predator that was declared extinct in 1930; the duo meets with a hunter that shot what is believed to be a wolf and uncovers evidence that suggests the species could be alive.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S01 E08 — The Dodo of the North
Forrest travels to the Faroe Islands to look for any trace of the great auk; his passionate search for a large flightless seabird takes him through some of the most scenic and rugged terrain he's ever seen.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E11 — Low Rider
Tumor lowers the chances of a dog finding a forever home; violent dog puts the VRC staff in danger; search is on for stray dog's owner.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S08 E10 — A New Best Friend
Tia and her crew race to rescue an abandoned pit bull stranded in an empty house; at Villalobos, Tia's dog Jethro falls dangerously ill while a mother and daughter arrive seeking a new best friend.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E11 — The Dogs That Stole Our Hearts
Tia, her children and the extended Villalobos family reveal behind-the-scenes stories about the dogs that stole their hearts over the years.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E01 — Pressure Cooker
Two teachers from Massachusetts fall in love with a deaf puppy they hope to give a forever home; a house fire reveals a massive dog-hoarding situation; Earl's wisdom isn't enough to keep one of the parolees from getting into trouble.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E02 — Golden Girl
Mariah faces a challenging rescue when she realizes the dog in danger is deaf; former adopters come back to Villalobos set on adopting a special-needs dog; the rescue struggles to track a dog's owner because of outdated microchip information.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E06 — Fire Dog
A potential best friend needs to pass a unique test before he can be adopted out; parolee Jammall returns after a mysterious absence; a year after losing their house in a fire, M2 and Kanani do something special for the dog who saved their lives.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E07 — Like a Boss
Tia and Country Matt team up to rescue an aggressive dog; a local law student wants to adopt a dog that can go running with her; a dog is brought in with a serious skin condition and tumors.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:
S13 E04 — Southern Dogs in the City
Villalobos is invited to participate in Dog Bowl, creating a chance for a handful of dogs to steal the spotlight; M2 helps a neglected dog left in horrible conditions; a couple take the first step towards becoming parents by adopting a dog.

title: Pit Bulls and Parolees
description:

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E10 — Puppy Surprise: Pint Sized
Ralphie is the only boy while Maltese mix, Coco has a surprise litter at urban animal shelter. Ragdoll kitten, Jolene is a handful for her mom.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E11 — Cuddly Kittens: Pint Sized
A Shetland Sheepdog pup is constantly distracted by Gino the Pomeranian; Charlie is the one Manx in a litter full that has a tail.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E12 — Fab & Furless Kittens: Pint Sized
Abyssinian kitten gets into all the craft supplies in her home; Elf kitten Pixie searches for a friend.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S05 E13 — Puppy Pros: Pint Sized
A rare litter of Portuguese Podengo Pequeno pups is brought into the world by the resident dog about town, Izzy; Cockapoo octuplets are being trained to be therapy dogs.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E03 — Bacon and Tomato's Big Adventure
The staff becomes concerned when Jupiter, the rescued sea lion, is not himself; the Ocean Voyager exhibit awaits its new residents, black-blotched fantail stingray siblings Bacon and Tomato; Shelley the shy box turtle makes friends.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E01 — Big Is Beautiful
After eating all his tankmate's food, Tank the hungry sea turtle finds a space to eat in peace; two beluga whales are welcomed to their new home at the aquarium; Scarlett the lovable sea lion turns 2.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E04 — Coral Super Bowl
The staff becomes concerned when beloved African penguin Zola falls mysteriously ill; the aquarium witnesses the annual spawning of an endangered coral species; Maggie the false map turtle has a date with the dentist.

title: Tanked
description:
S10 E01 — 100 Episodes STRONG!
Assembling a Florida Gators-themed tank for alumnus, WWE Superstar, former tag-team champion and one half of the Prime-Time Players, Titus O'Neil, to commemorate the 100th episode.

title: Tanked
description:
S10 E02 — Johnny Damon is Expecting the Unexpected
Two-time MLB World Series champion Johnny Damon and his wife, expecting a child, want the ATM crew to help reveal the gender of their baby at a party by building two different tanks.

title: Tanked
description:
S10 E03 — Nick Carter Wants His Tank That Way
ATM builds a paddle boat-themed aquarium in Los Angeles for Nick Carter of the popular boy band Backstreet Boys.

title: Tanked
description:
S10 E04 — Prince Fielder's Big Hit
ATM builds a large, saltwater aquarium in the man cave of the Texas Rangers' first baseman, Prince Fielder, for his Orlando, Fla., home.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E01 — Merry Fishmas!
Pete and his crew are tasked with building a nature center, 14 feet off the ground at 10,000-acre nature preserve, Dogwood Canyon in Lampe, Missouri, established by Bass Pro Shops founder Johnny Morris, for the company's upcoming Christmas party.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E01 — Nelson Family Treehouse
Pete Nelson uproots an existing treehouse from the family-owned bed & breakfast Treehouse Point to build a custom-made treehouse as a housewarming gift for his daughter, Emily.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E07 — Magical Party Pad
A magical castle treehouse to inspire artistic endeavors; partying is the task for Pete and his crew in eastern Nebraska.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E06 — Sunrise Day Camp Clubhouse
Pete builds a clubhouse for a camp for children battling cancer; a crow's nest outpost and peek-a-boo roof for full interaction with nature.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E09 — Home Tree Home
Inspired by South American treehouse maestro Richard Brunnelli, Pete builds a hexagonal live-in treehouse for a Treehouse Workshop graduate in coastal Oregon.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E03 — Mindbending Silver Maple
Pete finds inspiration in old tales to build a mesmerizing treehouse, with a curved turret that soars two stories high and a deck to take in the amazing sights, over the stems of a twisty silver maple on the shore of Lake Chelan.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E02 — Texas-Sized Treehouse
Pete and the crew round up the magnificent seven of cypresses alongside the Frio River and moseys on down to Leakey, Texas to build a gigantic, Texas-sized treehouse with the longest bridge in NT&S history.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E03 — Rustic English Re-tree-t
A herd of goats stands in the way of Pete building an elegant English retreat with a luxurious hanging bed on an idyllic farm in Waxhaw, N.C.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E04 — Treehouse Z
Pete has a nine-day window to build a Zen-like sanctuary for some old friends in the shadow of the Blue Ridge Mountains in Canton, N.C.

description:

A water moccasin is spotted near a home; 6-foot-long rattlesnake; Paul and Scott pull a prank on Ashley and Chris.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S02 E05 — No Time for Gators
A nuisance call leads to a dangerous encounter with two bloodthirsty lizards; Tre and Jimmy bring alligators to a saloon.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E07 — The Aussie Way
The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species; ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task; Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E14 — Disco Spider
A look at why some spiders disco dance; a mysterious creature is preying on Europe's sheep; a whole town is engulfed by bubbling foam.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E12 — Handsome Hog
Howie the rescued wallaby is ready to be relocated to Arizona, where he will meet his new mob and potential mates; red river hogs Hampton and Athena are paired for breeding; little penguin Jaffa must undergo eye surgery to restore his vision.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E09 — Lemur Love
At the zoo and the New York Aquarium, bull sea lions Clyde and Tacoma trade places to meet a new set of girlfriends; Sifaka lemurs Gemina and Andri form a new breeding pair to help their species.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E10 — Kangaroos in Trees
The zoo's lone kangaroo is getting a mate, and the staff is hopeful for a new generation; after months of quarantine, it's moving day for a pair of Mang Mountain pit vipers, and African spoonbill chick Sterling shares a special bond with his keeper.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E11 — Bronx Blizzard
The zoo welcomes Edward the bat-eared fox as its newest ambassador animal; Amani the aardvark undergoes dental surgery, and the pelican flock gets a new winter home; a snow day means playtime for the animals and hard work for the zoo staff.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E03 — New Cats on the Block
Rescued harbor seal pup Sydney finds a new family at the New York Aquarium; zoo staff are challenged when a skittish Amur tiger struggles to adjust to its new home.

title: The Zoo
description:
S05 E02 — Bouncing Troody
A keel-billed toucan confiscated from smugglers begins a new life at the zoo; Troody the young red kangaroo has big shoes to fill; a herd of Bactrian fawns prepares to go on exhibit; the gorillas enjoy a new form of entertainment.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E02 — A Brave Little Dog
Dr. Jeff treats a dog with a mysterious injury; Dr. Petra helps vet tech Jes' Dalmatian after it eats something toxic; a neglected turtle needs a new home, and the team falls in love with a litter of stray kittens.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E01 — At Home With Wolves
A girl hopes Dr. Jeff can save her puppy from a deadly virus; a stray cat with a life-threatening injury; Dr. Jeff must gain the trust of rescued wolves to help an ailing member of the pack.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E06 — A Tiger's Tale
Dr. Jeff gives hope to a concerned owner when their dog is diagnosed with cancer; the team cares for a litter of abandoned kittens; Dr. Amy solves the mystery of a beloved cat's painful injury; Dr. Jeff and Hector help a rescued tiger find love.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E03 — Blown Away
A dog is lost during a windstorm; Dr. Baier treats a small bird that has a big personality; a paralyzed dog is abandoned; an alligator is injured in a fight.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E05 — Runaway Dog
Dr. Jeff treats a skittish Savannah cat with an unusual condition; Dr. Amy helps a beloved dog who was injured chasing a coyote; the team tries to find the owners of a dog rescued on the highway.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E07 — Tiny Soul Mate
Dr. Jeff and Hector help 40 miniature Australian shepherds rescued from a puppy mill; vet tech Christine turns to Dr. Jeff when her elderly Chihuahua has trouble walking; Dr. Jeff is called out to treat an alpaca with a serious infection.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S06 E04 — A Lucky Break
Dr. Jeff helps a dog with a serious illness; Mel and her daughter rescue a baby squirrel; Dr. Jeff and Dr. Petra team up to save a beloved cat hit by a car; Dr. Baier gives a rabbit owner a surprise; a tiny dog with a big spirit needs a home.

title: Dr. Dee: Alaska Vet
description:
S02 E02 — On the Edge of Nowhere
Dr. Dee and her husband Ken host a clinic in a town with a population of 107; back at Animal House, Dr. Dee races to save an Akita with a gunshot wound.

title: Dr. Dee: Alaska Vet
description:
S02 E03 — High on the Hog
Dr. Dee hosts a pet tricks competition to raise funds for a no-kill animal shelter in Fairbanks; surgery for a pot-bellied pig named Lilly Lou is full of surprises; stallion of Dr. Dee's long-time friend has a possibly deadly tumor.

description:

A baby alligator with a taped-shut jaw roams a nearby creek; the closing of Everglades Holiday Park could spell the end of the Gator Boys.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S03 E01 — Mississippi or Bust
The Gator Boys leave Everglades Holiday Park; Jimmy locates an alligator ranch in Mississippi; Paul has a big decision to make.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E03 — Mr. Bad Guy
In southern Louisiana, Lt. David Nunez and Sgt. Austin Arteaga investigate a group of bird hunters on opening day of teal season; a repeated offender is busted for taking immature crabs; a late-night deer decoy leads to a hunter in handcuffs.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E02 — Road Killer
In Jackson Parish, a reckless hunter is investigated for shooting down a highway; agents stake out a man suspected of two illegal deer kills; duck hunters are confronted for harassment; a crowded boat parade ends with citations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E07 — In the Eye of Hurricane Ida
As Hurricane Ida makes landfall, wildlife agents deploy to help the people of Louisiana; an injured woman is trapped in a flooded hotel; elderly neighbors await rescue in punishing conditions; lifesaving supplies must be delivered to those in need.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E05 — Blind Rage
As a storm rolls in over St. Tammany Parish, Cpl. Blaine Wagner and Cpl. Rick Clark assist in a search-and-rescue mission for a missing fisherman; agents confront a repeat offender for harassing hunters, and a felon is caught with an illegal firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E04 — Spy in the Sky
While using the LDWF's spy in the sky drone, agents track down a boat captain breaking the law in Plaquemines Parish; a family of shrimpers is investigated for pulling oversized nets; two feuding fishermen are suspected of being under the influence.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E06 — Deer in the Headlights
In Ouachita Parish, a trespassing investigation leads to a dicey encounter and multiple seizures of deer; agents confront a group of duck hunters who are spotted killing non-game birds; health code violations are found during a routine oyster patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E01 — Monster Crabber
Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E05 — Operation Caviar
Wardens kick off "Operation Caviar," enforcing a strict one-fish limit; other wardens conduct spot checks for licenses and tags, aiming to protect fish populations and promote responsible fishing.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E11 — Deploy the Decoy
Wardens tackle elk harassment, illegal shootings and rescue a deer.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S03 E05 — Great Day to Be in Montana
Warden Taylor keeps the peace between hunters and landowners; Warden Golie first gets to the bottom of a curious case and later is shocked by hunters' behavior; Warden Luepke has a teachable moment with hunters who harvest deer illegally.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S03 E07 — Overtime Pay
Warden Taylor looks into hunters reported on a property without the landowner's permission; Warden Burroughs makes a tough decision when deer get their antlers stuck during a fight; Wardens Holland and Taylor investigate elk hunters harassing a herd.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E10 — Poaching for Profit
Discovering the lives of conservation officers of Montana defending public lands, handling antipoaching sting operations, and more.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E08 — Aerial Patrols and Ground Operations
Wardens use new aircraft to patrol from above; on the ground, wardens experience a crazy weekend during the Yellowstone Boat Float and ensure participants comply with the law; their coordinated efforts enhance safety and order in the region.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E06 — Safety and Skills
A look at the lives of Montana conservation officers who defend public lands, handle anti-poaching sting operations and more.

title: Yellowstone Wardens
description:
S06 E09 — Wounded Deer Duty
Wardens in Region 2 respond to a TIP Mont call about a potential elk violation, conducting a detailed investigation; in Region 4, a warden assists hunters in recovering a wounded deer, ensuring proper procedures are followed.
